findings: read-only public CLI over COLUMNAR_DATASET_V1 serves the frozen corpus with zero dataset-byte changes and zero network attempts
dataset-driven compare reproduces the G1-C mapped class counts exactly on all four dual filings; PROVEN_EQUIVALENT-only identity rewrite preserved
IBE single-variant + FALLBACK_TO_ES and TEF 20484 scoped lifecycle are intact on the public surface

limitations: CLI V1 exposes read-only queries only; capture/update/API surfaces are deliberately out of scope
facts uses a bounded list (--limit, default 100; 0 = unbounded) rather than cursor pagination
dataset_validate is the deep check; ordinary commands still verify file hashes + row counts + schemas before serving
human tables truncate wide values for readability; JSON/JSONL is always complete
